scope: Interactive HTML/CSS/SVG design study, not a Unity or engine integration
checks: Initial position offers a 3-damage preview without applying damage.
Desktop and mobile layouts have no horizontal overflow and retain the H mark.
Movement preview leaves position untouched; commit moves to D4, spends one step and changes the height-dependent forecast.
Changing selection preserves the previous unit’s remaining actions.
Firing spends the attack once; keyboard shortcuts cannot repeat it and movement stays available.
A lethal forecast removes only the chosen opponent and updates the army count.
End turn allows cancellation; confirmation refreshes actions without pretending to simulate an opponent.
All eight appearance choices agree across board, portrait and squad while preserving stats and forecast.
Dismissing the appearance editor discards an unapplied choice.
Keyboard selection restores a target after clearing the preview.
Motion control and the accessible visual guide work.
On mobile the appearance grid scrolls to all eight choices and its apply button remains usable.
Direct file opening initializes the study without a server or external assets.
No page errors or failed requests during the interaction run.
